title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Use a default quantity of 1 for all types on documents – Customization
summary: Business Central by default sets quantity to 1 only for Item and G/L Account line types on sales and purchase documents, but not for Resource, Fixed Asset, or Charge types. This post shows how to customize the system to apply default quantity of 1 to other document line types using table extensions and event subscribers.
key_points: Default quantity of 1 is currently limited to Item type in sales documents and G/L Account type in both sales and purchase documents
Resource, Fixed Asset, and Charge (Item) line types lack this default quantity feature out of the box
Two customization approaches are provided: using setup table fields with event handlers, or using field extension triggers for simpler one-time implementations
The solution uses event subscribers like OnAfterAssignResourceValues and OnAfterAssignFixedAssetValues to apply default quantities

quotes.text: As of now, the default quantity setting of 1 is only valid for Item type and G/L Account type.
quotes.why_it_matters: This explains the core limitation that drives the need for customization across different line types.

quotes.text: So if you need other types to be available as well, this will need to be customized.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that extending default quantity to Resource, Fixed Asset, and other types requires custom development.
